_comment: What fine paper is pulped from. Vanilla has no stripped-logs tag of its own -- `#minecraft:logs`
carries bark and the nether stems -- so the list is written out here.
Stripped, because bark is taken off before pulping in the real craft: it is mostly lignin and it
specks the sheet. The nether hyphae are left out for the same reason they are not wood.
Bamboo is in on purpose rather than by accident -- it is one of the oldest papermaking fibres there is.
